runc version 1.5.2
commit: 29dd3dc2b13b4123162e5fe132504bb4b15569f1
spec: 1.3.0

runCommand: grep Seccomp /proc/self/status; grep -Eq "^Seccomp:[[:space:]]+2$" /proc/self/status; test "$(cat /proc/1/comm)" = docker-init; echo enoughfactory-owned-engine-init-ok
